changeSet.sql: IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM sys.indexes WHERE name='IX_GraphAssetEdge_Uid') BEGIN CREATE NONCLUSTERED INDEX IX_GraphAssetEdge_Uid ON [graph].[AssetEdge] ([Uid])] END
